__doc: No explorer knows these — they are protocol figures — so this file is the
simplest way to feed them: same-origin, no CORS, no infrastructure.
Fill in the numbers below and redeploy. A field left null shows as an em
dash on the site rather than a number that isn't real, so it is safe to
Keys are plain numbers, not strings, and not pre-formatted:
totalFeesCollected   USD, all fees the pool has generated
totalDistributedUsd  optional — omit and the site derives it from the
holders              optional — overrides the explorer lookup
history is optional: 3+ points per metric, oldest to newest, drawn as the
tile's sparkline. Keys are fees, distributed, holders, marketCap,
liquidity, volume24h. Without it the site records its own rolling series.
Once a real source exists (see README ▸ Rewards), point
sources.rewards.url at that instead and this file can go.
